modelNote: Reconstructed here from the morning-after-Selection-Sunday T-Rank Barthag ratings using Bart Torvik’s documented neutral-court log5 formula. Exact bracket propagation averages over every possible opponent, including the First Four. Ratings are held fixed; no tournament results or later information enter these probabilities. This is not a forecast published by FiveThirtyEight or Bart Torvik, and it does not add matchup, injury, venue or rating-uncertainty adjustments.

ensembleReport.method: Expanding-window tests: each tested season uses only earlier seasons to fit. Equal weight per season. Individual comparisons use exactly the same games as their ensemble comparator. Available source sets vary by historical season; this tests the blending procedure, not today’s fitted coefficients.
